tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, menus, inputs — anything that sits on bg.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: table headers, code blocks, sidebar, disabled fields.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative only — never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and other controls (3:1 on bg and surface in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints, placeholders, table headers on bg, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action fill (one per view), selected states, active tab marker.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill for accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill. Never hard-code white — dark theme uses deep lilac.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Pastel lilac fill: selected rows, soft buttons, info chips, nav highlight.

tokens.name: on-accent-soft
tokens.usage: Text on accent-soft.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links on bg and surface.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Secondary brand fill: secondary buttons, positive highlights, tags.

tokens.name: sage-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for sage.

tokens.name: on-sage
tokens.usage: Text and icons on sage and sage-hover.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid keyboard focus ring, offset 2px from the control (3:1 on every surface in both themes).

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success alert / badge fill.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Success text and icon on success-soft, bg and surface. Always paired with an icon or word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning alert / badge fill (pastel peach).

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Warning text and icon on warning-soft, bg and surface.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Danger alert / badge fill (pastel rose).

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Danger text and icon on danger-soft, bg and surface; field error messages.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive button fill and error borders.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Info alert / badge fill (pastel sky).

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Info text and icon on info-soft, bg and surface.

tokens.name: disabled-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of a disabled default, soft button or file picker button.

tokens.name: on-disabled
tokens.usage: Text on disabled-fill, and on a disabled ghost button (3.7:1 light, 4.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: disabled-line
tokens.usage: Border of a disabled default button.

tokens.name: accent-disabled
tokens.usage: Fill of a disabled primary button. Stays lilac so the button still reads as the primary action.

tokens.name: on-accent-disabled
tokens.usage: Text on accent-disabled (4.2:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: sage-disabled
tokens.usage: Fill of a disabled secondary button.

tokens.name: on-sage-disabled
tokens.usage: Text on sage-disabled (3.8:1 light, 4.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: danger-disabled
tokens.usage: Fill of a disabled danger button.

tokens.name: on-danger-disabled
tokens.usage: Text on danger-disabled (3.7:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Behind a modal ls-dialog (::backdrop). Dims the page so the dialog reads as the only thing to act on.

tokens.name: toast
tokens.usage: ls-toast fill. Darker than the page in light and lighter in dark, so a toast stands apart from any surface it floats over.

tokens.name: on-toast
tokens.usage: Text on toast: 14.7:1 light, 8.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: toast-action
tokens.usage: The action button's text on toast (Undo): 7.8:1 light, 6.9:1 dark.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Marketing heroes and empty-state headlines only.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: IDs, code, keys. Inline code sits on surface-sunken.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding, compact card padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default card padding, form row gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page top/bottom margins on wide screens.

tokens.name: form-help-gap
tokens.usage: Inside ls-field: label to control, control to help or error text.

tokens.name: form-field-gap
tokens.usage: ls-form: one field to the next.

tokens.name: form-actions-gap
tokens.usage: ls-form: last field to the form's action buttons.

tokens.name: form-section-gap
tokens.usage: ls-form: one sub-section to the next inside a card.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tabs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, alerts.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Switches, avatars, pill filters.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting cards. Prefer the line border; add this only to lift.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modal dialogs, the highest layer.

tokens.name: dialog-sm
tokens.usage: ls-dialog--sm: confirmations and one-field prompts.

tokens.name: dialog-md
tokens.usage: ls-dialog (default): record details and short forms.

tokens.name: dialog-lg
tokens.usage: ls-dialog--lg: filtered lists and tables.

tokens.name: popover-width
tokens.usage: Widest an ls-popover detail card grows.

tokens.name: tooltip-width
tokens.usage: Widest an ls-popover--tip tooltip grows.

tokens.name: overlay-margin
tokens.usage: Smallest gap between a dialog and the viewport edge. A popover is at most the viewport width less this gap on each side.

tokens.name: popover-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between a popover and the element it points at, and between a popover and the viewport edge.

tokens.name: toast-width
tokens.usage: Widest an ls-toast grows. Narrower screens use the viewport width less overlay-margin on each side.

tokens.name: toast-min-height
tokens.usage: Height of a one-line ls-toast. A floating primary action moves up by this much plus space-2 while a toast shows.

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: Height of ls-tabbar above the safe area. ls-toasts and a floating primary action sit above it on a phone.

tokens.name: board-column-width
tokens.usage: Width of an ls-column on a desktop board. On a phone the board shows one column at a time at full width.

motion.note: Every token here drops to its reducedMotion value under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. Animate only opacity, translate, scale and colour.

tokens.name: motion-quick
tokens.usage: Colour and press states, chevrons, a lifted item's shadow, and anything leaving the screen.

tokens.name: motion-base
tokens.usage: Dialogs, popovers and toasts arriving; rows sliding aside; a dropped item settling; a row folding away.

tokens.name: motion-travel
tokens.usage: Movement across most of the screen: a full-screen dialog or sheet rising on a phone, drilling into a screen and back.

tokens.name: motion-flash
tokens.usage: How long ls-flash marks the row a link pointed at. Kept under reduced motion, where the mark holds and then clears without fading.

tokens.name: ease-enter
tokens.usage: Arriving and moving: decelerates into place. No overshoot.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Leaving: accelerates away.
